timed_scope: Each function's prepared path, entry(name), held once, on Cells built before the clock: validation, the probe, result conversion. cells_from_buffers is timed apart. Excludes the host, Excel, and building inputs. Each row is one batch; per_call_us is that batch's mean.
allocation_scope: tracemalloc peak of the Python heap during one warm call, numpy data included, the host's pinned buffers excluded.
